env -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONUSERBASE -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 benchmarks/work/release_alert_refresh_20261001/venv/bin/python -I -B -c 'import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import check
from benchmark_tools.render_profile_stratum_review import STYLE
base = Path.cwd() / "benchmark_tools/results"
stem = "publication_native_fas_figure_manuscript_20261010_v1"
plain = json.loads((base / (stem + "_assets.json")).read_text())
styled = json.loads((base / (stem + "_assets_v2.json")).read_text())
printed = json.loads((base / (stem + "_print/print.json")).read_text())
layout = json.loads((base / (stem + "_layout/report.json")).read_text())
journal = json.loads((base / "publication_native_fas_review_execution_20261010_v1.json").read_text())
refs = [plain["html"], *plain["sources"], *plain["targets"], styled["html"], *styled["sources"], *styled["targets"], printed["pdf"], *printed["checked_records"], *layout["checked_records"], *layout["rendered_pages"]]
for ref in refs: check(ref)
assert Path(styled["html"]["path"]).read_text().replace(STYLE, "", 1) == Path(plain["html"]["path"]).read_text()
assert journal["tests"]["terminal"]["exit_code"] == 0 and "41 passed" in journal["tests"]["terminal"]["output"]
assert printed["status"] == "verified_html_printed" and printed["page_count"] == layout["page_count"] == 34
assert not layout["bounds_violations"]
assert len(plain["citation_ids"]) == 19 and plain["local_occurrences"] == 158 and plain["unique_targets"] == 153 and not plain["untracked_targets"]
assert journal["manual_visual_review"]["pages"] == [int(Path(item["path"]).stem.split("_")[1]) for item in layout["rendered_pages"]]
assert "--no-sandbox" not in printed["command"]
assert plain["sources"][0]["sha256"] == journal["manuscript"]["sha256"]
guide = (Path.cwd() / "benchmark_tools/PUBLICATION_REPRODUCTION.md").read_text()
for suffix in ("_review_v2.html", "_print/document.pdf", "_assets_v2.json", "_layout/report.json"):
    assert stem + suffix in guide
assert journal["publication_ready"] is False and journal["manual_visual_review"]["full_document_visual_review_complete"] is False
print(json.dumps({"status":"current_review_readback_passed","direct_refs_checked":len(refs),"science_html_unchanged":True,"pages":34,"selected_visual_pages":journal["manual_visual_review"]["pages"],"no_sandbox_flag":False,"manuscript_sha256":journal["manuscript"]["sha256"],"scientific_recomputation":False},sort_keys=True))'
